answer_1.quote: Previous efforts on metaphor generation demonstrate the task can bring benefits to a wide range of NLG downstream tasks... In this paper, we mainly focus on generating the nominal metaphors.
answer_1.outputs: Generated nominal metaphors (e.g., "Lilies like a bottle of perfume")

answer_2.quote: Automatic Metrics We use perplexity (PPL) to evaluate the fluency of the generated text... Dist-1 and Dist-2 compute the distinct unigrams and bigrams ratio of generated text... To test the metaphoricity (Meta) of generated outputs, we train a RoBERTa-based Chinese metaphor classifier on CMC to compute the ratio of metaphorical utterances in the generated sentences.

answer_4.quote: We also perform human evaluation based on the following three criteria: 1) Fluency indicates how well the metaphor is formed; 2) Consistency indicates whether the metaphor make sense; 3) Creativity scores how creative annotators think the metaphor is. Three annotators were instructed to rate the three criteria from 1 to 5.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate Fluency, Consistency, and Creativity on a 1‑5 scale for each generated metaphor.
